findings.description: Two plumes come from the same stationary truck over the same seconds, but they drift in opposite directions. The large dark plume behind the cab rises and drifts up-left, while a second whitish plume at ground level by the front bumper rises and drifts right (00:02.5-00:06). Neither source has a visible exhaust stack or outlet, and there is no airflow that would split the plumes this way. Both then thin out and are mostly gone by 00:07 while the truck stays in place.
